blocks.title: Macroscopic waqiat
blocks.text: Macroscopic waqiat woh mazahir hain jo amal mein shamil alag alag zarraat ya molecules par ghaur kiye baghair nangi aankh se dekhe ja sakte hain.

Rang ki tabdeeli, hararat ka kharij ya jazb hona, precipitate ka banna, gas ka nikalna, hajm ya dabao ki tabdeeli, aur kimiyai reaction mein kisi madde ki tarkeeb ki tabdeeli macroscopic khusoosiyat ki misalein hain.

blocks.prompt: Do be-rang solutions milane par test tube garam ho jati hai aur peela thos beth jata hai. Kaun se macroscopic waqiat dekhe gaye?
blocks.explanation: Hararat ka kharij hona (tube garam), rang ki tabdeeli (be-rang se peela) aur precipitate ka banna (thos ka bethna) sab macroscopic waqiat hain, jo un ions aur molecules ka hawala diye baghair dekhe gaye jo unhen paida karte hain.

items: Macroscopic waqiat nangi aankh se nazar aate hain: rang ki tabdeeli, hararat ka kharij ya jazb hona, precipitate, gas, hajm, dabao ya tarkeeb ki tabdeeli.
